name: dsh-session-progress
description: Per-session task progress bar in the DSH sidebar: samples the running turn with a low-effort model, then paints a translucent #90AFFF bar across the session row.
author: Ne_Rn (https://github.com/Yu-jianhai)

scripts.test: node test/host-smoke.mjs && node test/route-fallback.mjs && node test/panel-group.mjs
scripts.check: node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/client.js && node --check test/host-smoke.mjs && node --check test/route-fallback.mjs && node --check test/panel-group.mjs

dshhub.summary: 在 DSH 侧栏的每个会话行上铺一条 60% 透明度的 #90AFFF 进度色带：每 30 秒用一个最轻思考强度的模型读当前轮次上下文、给出 0–100 的进度，并在左侧栏「进度日志」页展示判断模型的每一次原始输出。
